metadata.method_name: D2 host-entry anchoring vs co-transfer (PPML, grafting test)
metadata.description: One example per screen MAIN kw5 host-entry event (concept c enters non-origin subfield d in year e). input = W1 features; output = Y_strict (W2 host papers by author-disjoint newcomers). predict_baseline = out-of-fold mean from the controls-only Poisson model (M0); predict_method = M0 + anchoring A_cont + co-transfer CT (M1).

oos.note: grouped-by-concept 5-fold out-of-fold predictions; descriptive predictive check, not the inferential test (concept x e FE cannot be used for unseen concepts)

metadata.demo_subset: 100 of 1740 events from full_method_out.json, chosen so the concept x e + d x e FE design stays identified after singleton/separation pruning
